$comment: Vercel WAF rate-limit rules for the cloud-service, store and license endpoints. Source of truth for docs/CLOUD_SERVICE.md#global-rate-limits-vercel-waf. Apply with scripts/firewall-rules.mjs (stages drafts only; the owner reviews and publishes). Limits are per client IP, per Vercel region, fixed window; window is in seconds (Pro allows 10-600).

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-notams
rules.description: GET /api/data/notams per IP (FAA NOTAM quota). Mirror: 1 req per airport per 30 min.

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-stocks
rules.description: GET /api/data/stocks and /api/data/stock-profiles per IP (Finnhub quota). Mirror: 1 req per symbol per 5 min.

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-oauth-config
rules.description: GET /api/oauth/config per IP. Mirror caches it 10 min (1 min after a failure).

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-oauth-token
rules.description: POST /api/oauth/google/token per IP (code exchange + hourly refresh per Google account).

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-license
rules.description: POST /api/license/* per IP (mirror activate/refresh + license page). Mirror: refresh daily, hourly retry; at boot a key file is retried every 30 s for 10 min (20 calls).

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-payment-intent
rules.description: POST /api/create-payment-intent per IP (card-testing brake; the function also allows 20/hour). Checkout creates one per visit to the payment step.

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-tax
rules.description: POST /api/calculate-tax per IP (each call is a Stripe Tax calculation; function allows 60/hour). One per address change at checkout.

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-promo
rules.description: POST /api/validate-promo per IP (stops promo-code guessing; function allows 20/hour). A buyer tries a code or two.

rules.name: skyglass-ratelimit-waitlist
rules.description: POST /api/waitlist per IP (function allows 10/hour per IP, 3/hour per address). One signup per visitor.
